pair_surface:
Normalize each story by strip + collapse ASCII whitespace; order the two normalized stories by SHA-256 digest; concatenate as 'STORY_A
<text>
STORY_B
<text>'.
tokenizer_for_lexical_parent: lowercase regex [a-z0-9]+ over each normalized story; Jaccard over token sets

P0_LEXICAL.decision: Jaccard<=lo => REJECT; Jaccard>=hi => ACCEPT; otherwise CANNOT_CHECK
P0_LEXICAL.selection: maximize CALIBRATION exact3; ties: lower invalid_false_accept, then higher valid_accept, then lexicographically smaller (lo,hi)

P1_DIRECT_TEXT.decision: If argmax class is CANNOT_CHECK, emit CANNOT_CHECK. Otherwise emit argmax only when max class probability>=tau; else CANNOT_CHECK.
P1_DIRECT_TEXT.selection: maximize CALIBRATION exact3; ties: lower invalid_false_accept, higher valid_accept, lower tau

E_FACTORISED_STRUCTURAL.decision: ACCEPT iff p_rel>=tau_rel AND p_ent_low>=tau_ent; REJECT iff p_rel<=1-tau_rel OR p_ent_low<=1-tau_ent; otherwise CANNOT_CHECK. ACCEPT precedence is evaluated first; with tau>=0.5 the clauses cannot conflict except exactly at 0.5, where ACCEPT precedence is frozen.
E_FACTORISED_STRUCTURAL.selection: Among threshold pairs satisfying CALIBRATION invalid_false_accept<=0.15 AND valid_accept>=0.50, maximize exact3; ties: lower invalid_false_accept, higher valid_accept, lexicographically smaller (tau_rel,tau_ent). If none, DEVELOPMENT_NEGATIVE_NO_SAFE_THRESHOLD and do not inspect confirmatory labels.

strongest_parent: After P0 and P1 calibration, choose higher exact3; ties within 1e-15 select P0_LEXICAL.

falsifiability_numeric_contract.TEXT_DESTRUCTION: Use random seed 2026081401 to independently permute first-story and second-story positions across CALIBRATION rows before candidate transformation. Original candidate exact3 - destroyed candidate exact3 >=0.10.
falsifiability_numeric_contract.RELATION_HEAD_SHUFFLE: Permute p_rel with seed 2026081402; >=0.05 of CALIBRATION decision vector must change.
falsifiability_numeric_contract.ENTITY_HEAD_SHUFFLE: Permute p_ent_low with seed 2026081403; >=0.05 of CALIBRATION decision vector must change.
falsifiability_numeric_contract.HEAD_SWAP: Swap p_rel and p_ent_low without refitting; >=0.05 of CALIBRATION decisions must change.
falsifiability_numeric_contract.GOLD_SHUFFLE: Permute CALIBRATION gold with seed 2026081404 after every arm is frozen; candidate-minus-strongest-parent exact3 advantage under shuffled gold must be <0.02.
falsifiability_numeric_contract.TRIVIAL_CONTROLS: No constant decision may jointly have valid_accept>=0.65 and invalid_false_accept<=0.15 on CALIBRATION.

bootstrap.unit: confirmatory released pair row after leakage-component split

network_acquisition: Outcome-bearing runner must fetch the public StoryAnalogy CSV from the exact Hugging Face repository and record content SHA-256; a changed upstream byte stream is a new evidence subject but does not change this protocol.
